name: Foundation of the Cistercian Order at Cîteaux
summary: Robert of Molesme founds the Abbey of Cîteaux in Burgundy as a return to strict Benedictine observance, manual labour, austerity, and silence. Under Bernard of Clairvaux from 1115 the order expands explosively: ~340 houses across Europe by 1200.

_quarry.structural_significance: Drives the Romanesque-to-Gothic agrarian colonisation of forests and frontier lands across western Europe; standardised Cistercian water-management and stockbreeding raise rural productivity from Castile to Pomerania.
